names.red-zone-advancing: Red zone advancing! Move to the safe zone
names.backpack04_cloud-desc: You can equip an extra perk.
names.9mm-tooltip: Ammo for M9, MP5, G18C, MAC-10, M93R, UMP9, Vector, P30L, VSS and CZ-3A1.
names.12gauge-tooltip: Ammo for M870, M1100, MP220, SPAS-12, SPAS-16, Saiga-12, Super 90 and USAS-12.
names.762mm-tooltip: Ammo for OT-38, AK-47, Groza, DP-28, BAR, SCAR-H, M39, BLR, Mosin, M1 Garand, SVD-63, SV-98, AN-94 and PKP.
names.556mm-tooltip: Ammo for M416, FAMAS, Mk 12 SPR, L86A2, Scout Elite, IMD-2, QBB-97, M4A1-S and M249.
names.50AE-tooltip: Ammo for DEagle 50, S&W 500, Barrett M107 and ASh-12.
names.308sub-tooltip: Ammo for AWM-S and Mk 20 SSR.
names.45acp-tooltip: Ammo for M1911, M1A1, Peacemaker, Model 94, Vector and Mk45G.
names.outfitMaintainer-lore: // TODO: Come up with something funny
names.outfitMod-lore: For those who wield the power of the pan.
names.outfitParmaPrestige-lore: Special issue for staffers at Bunker 1.
names.outfitWoodland-lore: Common component of PARMA survival caches.
names.outfitDarkGloves-lore: True survivrs wear the dark gloves.
names.outfitDarkShirt-lore: Some survivrs wear the dark shirt.
names.outfitRed-lore: On the plus side, they won't see you bleed.
names.knuckles_rusted-lore: Rust up for the dust up.
names.windwalk-desc: When taking fire, gain a short burst of speed.
names.rare_potato-desc: Always rotate to a high quality weapon.
names.aoe_heal-desc: Reviving and using medical items affects all nearby players.
names.steelskin-desc: Take reduced damage and reflect enemy bullets.</br>Increased size.
names.ap_rounds-desc: Bullets are more effective against armored enemies and obstacles.
names.splinter-desc: Rounds fragment into three less powerful bullets.
names.small_arms-desc: Move faster with weapons deployed.</br>Decreased size.
names.takedown-desc: Kills grant health, boost and a short burst of speed.
names.combat_stims-desc: Consumables grant a temporary boost to bullet damage and allow them to heal allies.
names.lifeline-desc: Adrenaline loss slowed. Taking fatal damage consumes adrenaline to mitigate it.
names.tree_climbing-desc: Move through trees. Move faster in water.
names.scavenger-desc: Obstacles drop additional items when destroyed.
names.scavenger_adv-desc: Obstacles drop additional high-quality items when destroyed.
names.pirate-desc: Melee kills drop additional loot with a small chance for high-quality weapons.
names.hunted-desc: Your location is revealed to all enemies.
names.chambered-desc: First and last round in each magazine deal bonus damage.</br>Does not apply to shotguns.
names.martyrdom-desc: Release several live grenades upon death.
names.targeting-desc: Bullets deal bonus damage to players with perks.
names.bonus_45-desc: .45 ACP bullets deal bonus damage, with a chance of being further empowered.
names.broken_arrow-desc: Air strikes call in two additional fighters.
names.fabricate-desc: Periodically fill your pack with various explosives.
names.self_revive-desc: You can revive yourself when downed.
names.bonus_9mm-desc: 9mm bullets have increased speed, range, damage and spread.
names.flak_jacket-desc: Greatly reduces damage from explosions & shrapnel.</br>Increased grenade capacity.
names.amped_explosives-desc: Throwables travel farther and faster. Fragmenting explosives release more powerful shrapnel.
names.inspiration-desc: Your bugle call grants nearby allies a short burst of speed.
names.final_bugle-desc: When you die, nearby allies are bloodlusted for a short period of time.
names.high_velocity-desc: All your bullets travel significantly faster & further.
names.trick_nothing-desc: Tricked! This perk does absolutely nothing!
names.trick_size-desc: Tricked! You ate too much chicken and grew in size!
names.trick_m9-desc: Tricked! You've been cursed with a developer 'treat'!
names.trick_drain-desc: Tricked! You're bleeding very, very, VERY slowly!
names.treat_9mm-desc: Treat! 9mm bullets are darker and deadlier.
names.treat_12g-desc: Treat! 12 gauge pellets are darker and deadlier.
names.treat_556-desc: Treat! 5.56mm bullets are darker and deadlier.
names.treat_762-desc: Treat! 7.62mm bullets are darker and deadlier.
names.treat_super-desc: Super Treat! ALL your bullets are darker and deadlier.
